svg.text: Process × Role × Skill Intelligence Graph — Architecture
USER INTERFACE
React + Vite + Cytoscape.js
Explorer (graph + entity panel + evidence) · Cascade · Add (surprise record) · Jobs
APPLICATION / API LAYER
FastAPI — thin; delegates to pipeline / graph modules
/ingest · /entities · /nodes · /graph · /cascade · /evidence · /jobs
AI INTELLIGENCE LAYER
llm.py — one OpenAI-compatible entry point: JSON output, retry, rate-pacing, every call logged
analysts.py — one prompt per reasoning step · embeddings.py — MiniLM + FAISS retrieval
pipeline/: ingest (9 steps, resumable) · cascade reasoner · add_entity (live) · research · evidence
DATA & KNOWLEDGE LAYER
SQLite (default) / Postgres — one connection-string change
nodes: industries · stages · processes · activities · roles · skills
edges: ONE typed table for every relationship · overlays: ai_opportunities · skill_impacts · cascade_runs/results
evidence: sources · claim_evidence · operational: jobs (resumable) · llm_calls (audit)
FAISS index file — research-snippet vectors for retrieval
EXTERNAL RESEARCH / DATA
DuckDuckGo web search (no key) + local corpus/ (PDF, txt) — every snippet stored as a `sources` row before use
REST / JSON
structured calls + retrieval
Build: POST /ingest → 9-step pipeline (per-item commits) · Surprise record: POST /entities → same steps, smaller caps
Cascade: POST /cascade → bounded BFS from trigger, LLM judges "materially affected?" at each hop, per-result commit
